transcript.t: Before paper was invented, people in different places wrote on bamboo, silk or even stone. These materials were heavy or very expensive.
In ancient China, an officer named Cai Lun improved papermaking about 1,900 years ago. Workers used tree bark, old cloth and fishing nets to make thin sheets.
Paper was light and cheap, so more people could afford to read and write. Later on, the skill spread to other countries.
Today paper is everywhere, from books to boxes.
